notes.title: Version 0.7 is here!
notes.notes:
[b]World Ranking[/b]
- Now each score achieved in the Mexican village is sent to a world ranking, in addition to the personal ranking.
- The game indicates your position in the world ranking according to your best result.
- If you are among the top 10, everyone will see your name appear in the game!!!
- As a reminder, you must have unlocked the Mexican village to see the world and personal rankings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/60e8e5dc9069bdb0024fb94b742a57edb46ae1a5.jpg[/img]

[b]Android version in Free-2-Play[/b]
- The game is in early access on Google Play. Search Bullet Town to find it.
- The game is free but when a character is injured, you have to wait 20 minutes for him to be healed.
- The online store allows you to buy instant remedies, dollars to improve your characters directly...

[b]Discord Link[/b]
- We put a Discord link on the start menu. Come and participate in improving the game by giving your opinion, your advice, your desires, the bugs you found...

[b]Fixing various bugs[/b]

notes.title: Finally, the new major update: 0.61!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New Game Mode: Infinite Mexican Village with Leaderboard[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/be59cb64d4225341fb982f3e30b36688584fb1df.jpg[/img]

To access it, you must eliminate the Mexican Boss.

[h3][b]Mexican village[/b][/h3]
    - A brand new village has been integrated, with its typical architectural style.
    - Some buildings offer 3 levels of enemy positioning, making battles more difficult.
    - As the street is wider, buildings and enemies are further away, making battles more difficult.
    - There are no special buildings or events (store, mine, bank, duel) in this village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/4b04838b4e3ec4c2cb228c28d5b3c314eec262e2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Infinite game mode with leaderboard[/b][/h3]
    - The village is infinite. The game only ends when your character is mortally wounded.
    - You no longer earn dollars but points that are used for the leaderboard.
    - The leaderboard highlights the top 12 performances. It is currently personal but will become global in a future version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/79521eb90f2898584ebccd176ccf4d92b622e2ff.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Power gains[/h3][/b]
    - You gain a power of your choice every 3 battles, instead of every 2 battles.
    - Every 20 houses or so, a Boss fight awaits you. If you emerge victorious, you will win a special bullet.
    - You cannot gain more than 6 temporary powers, but there is no limitation on special bullets.
    - When you have the 6 temporary powers, you only gain improvements every 6 battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/8244bfdda0e4093dd2179d08561b1f0e0b5ec79d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New balancing[/b][/h1]
- The walking phases in the street are shorter. This required a complete rebalancing.
- You earn slightly less dollars per hit but engage in more battles.
- The objectives to unlock new characters have been revised for some.

[h1][b]Various improvements[/b][/h1]
- The timer is longer when there are at least 4 enemies.
- Transitions before Boss fights and in the saloon are improved.
- Enemies can no longer jump over a mammoth bullet.
- When you lose your hat, it falls slightly to the right so you can see it better.
- You can only hit a slot machine twice.
[h1][b]
Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
- The ace of spades is corrected.
- Bullets no longer pass through enemies.
- You can finally unlock Ducky Duke.
- You cannot kill a Pinkerton outside of a duel with him.

notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
[h3]New place: saloons[/h3]
- From the 3rd Boss onwards, all boss fights take place inside a saloon! It is filled with enemies that attack the player during the Boss battle. This makes the fights more interesting and intense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/6a3881e7ddfa9dc4137a3b5c20bf4892bb7b8189.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Boss Powers[/h3]
- The boss can now call new enemies for reinforcement in saloons.
- He doesn't lose his hat all at once. It takes several shots to take it off him.
- If there are too many enemies in the saloon, he can hide for a while to allow the player time to clean up.

[h3]Character Improvements[/h3]
- Some characters have been graphically redone to be more beautiful, more coherent and funnier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/ccb5e30877e88b3be405119cf46ef464cc740888.jpg[/img]

[h3]Less violence for children[/h3]
- Children love the game. Many of them come to play at the festivals where I show the game. Also to limit the violence of the game a little, the blood has been replaced by a simple red star.

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
- A lot of work has been done on optimizing the game. It has fewer slowdowns and it runs efficiently on older machines, and on mobile!
- In the 'Options' menu, a button allows you to remove some graphic elements in order to further simplify the operation of the graphics card.

[h3]UI[/h3]
- Graphics have been added for the transition phases, to make them prettier.
- Special bullet powers are circled to make them more visible.
- The aim cursor is more visible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/011b76f1ac7c524a0b4987dc17ed2fc2ec0b9427.jpg[/img]

[h3]Fixed many bugs[/h3]
- Bullets that didn't go away, the controller that didn't work sometimes, enemies that weren't colored correctly, camera that was poorly placed...
- All bugs mentioned in the discussion forum have been fixed.

[h3]New language: Spanish[/h3]

[h3]Shortly[/h3]
- The game will be released on Android mobile!

notes.title: V.0.27 is released!
notes.notes:
This new release includes :
- new powers : Hidden pocket, Aiming bullet, Silver bullet, 3 Bullets in a row

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/392d5faa454be3dab867290df3e9b759e3515c27.png[/img]

- new behaviors : the lady lost her ombrella if you shoot on it twice, so the lady boss is less difficult / the dynamite explosion make ennemies fly all around (funny :p)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/dcf487c49063fb82b44b98ff08a9b07ad02607e3.jpg[/img]

- UI enhancement : some UI have a destruction effect when you click on it (trying to make it more juicy) / the new run is launched directly when you choose a boss

- several bugs correction : some bullets weren't shot, some texts were cut, Escape button didn't work, the reward for killing the lady boss didn't show up, sometimes gamepad trigger shot twice...

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
You surely have noticed, the game has finally been released in Early Access !

[h3]So what's new in this version?[/h3]
[list]
[*]A better introduction with a new character : the marshall.
[*]A simple cinematic system for dialogues, with work on visual emotions.
[*]The possibility to have the time to experiment shooting on cans before fighting dangerous ennemies.
[*]A graphic refine of the first character.
[*]A better balancing, specially the second Boss who was too difficult.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256936/939c0f923414a0c0729e7d212c41eb76e467c4ed.jpg[/img]
[h3]What is next to come?[/h3]
[list]
[*]An enhancement to the quality of the animations of emotions.
[*]The creation of saloons for Boss fightings.
[/list]
[h3]Stay tune for next updates![/h3]

notes.title: Demo v0.24 released !!
notes.notes:
The v0.24 demo is finally available!!

We were a little in late in releasing it because we wanted to make it even more generous. We put so much into it that we're going to have to completely redo the game trailer ^^

You will find these improvements there:

- prettier interfaces, with a book that helps you manage your characters better and that gains new pages when you progress
- additional characters: a Pinkerton and a cowboy with long legs
- new gameplay features on the characters:
      - jumping: certain characters can jump in the air to dodge the bullets you send at their legs
      - the umbrella: the Lady bounces the balls with her umbrella
- additional powers
- and above all a whole new phase of gameplay: one-on-one duels

We wish you good fun! And above all, don't forget to give us feedback!
